reading.title: The Evolution of Sustainable Architecture in Modern Cities
reading.passage:
Sustainable architecture has emerged as a fundamental response to environmental challenges in contemporary urban development. Architects worldwide are increasingly incorporating green building technologies to reduce carbon emissions and minimize resource consumption. Notable examples include the integration of photovoltaic panels, rainwater harvesting systems, and passive heating mechanisms that significantly diminish energy dependency. These innovations not only decrease operational costs but also enhance occupant well-being through improved air quality and natural lighting.

The implementation of sustainable design principles extends beyond individual structures to influence entire urban ecosystems. Singapore's vertical gardens and Copenhagen's district heating networks demonstrate how comprehensive planning can transform cities into models of environmental stewardship. Furthermore, regulatory frameworks in Europe mandate that new constructions meet stringent sustainability standards, thereby accelerating the adoption of eco-friendly materials and renewable energy sources. This paradigm shift represents a critical evolution in architectural practice, reflecting society's commitment to long-term environmental preservation and climate action.

vocabulary.meaning_ko: 지속 가능한; 장기간 유지할 수 있는
패러다임 전환; 근본적인 사고 체계의 변화

questions.q: According to the passage, which of the following is mentioned as a benefit of sustainable architecture?
options: Increased labor costs for construction workers
Reduced operational costs and improved occupant well-being
Elimination of all traditional building materials
Complete independence from municipal water systems
questions.explanation: 지문 첫 번째 단락에서 'These innovations not only decrease operational costs but also enhance occupant well-being through improved air quality and natural lighting'이라고 명확히 명시되어 있습니다. 정답은 B입니다.

questions.q: What can be inferred from the passage about European cities?
options: They have abandoned traditional architecture entirely
They are subject to regulatory requirements for sustainable construction
They do not use renewable energy sources
They prioritize cost reduction over environmental concerns
questions.explanation: 지문의 'regulatory frameworks in Europe mandate that new constructions meet stringent sustainability standards'라는 문장으로부터, 유럽 도시들이 지속 가능한 건축에 관한 규제를 따라야 한다는 것을 추론할 수 있습니다. 정답은 B입니다.

questions.q: The word 'accelerating' in the second paragraph is closest in meaning to
options: Slowing down the process
Speeding up the adoption process
Temporarily halting progress
Maintaining the current rate
questions.explanation: 'accelerate'는 '가속화하다' 또는 '더 빠르게 진행하게 하다'는 의미입니다. 'speeding up'이 가장 가까운 의미의 표현입니다. 정답은 B입니다.

questions.q: Why does the author mention Singapore's vertical gardens and Copenhagen's district heating networks?
options: To criticize their architectural design
To show examples of cities implementing comprehensive sustainable planning
To argue that these solutions are too expensive
To demonstrate that only wealthy cities can afford sustainability
questions.explanation: 저자는 이 사례들을 '종합적인 계획이 도시를 환경 관리의 모델로 어떻게 변환할 수 있는지' 보여주기 위해 언급했습니다. 지문: 'demonstrate how comprehensive planning can transform cities into models of environmental stewardship.' 정답은 B입니다.

sentences.original: Sustainable architecture has emerged as a fundamental response to environmental challenges in contemporary urban development.
sentences.paraphrase: The rise of eco-friendly building design represents a crucial approach to addressing the environmental crises facing modern cities today.
sentences.tip: 동의어 치환(emerged→rise, fundamental→crucial, sustainable→eco-friendly, challenges→crises) 및 구조 재배열로 자연스럽게 패러프레이즈

sentences.original: These innovations not only decrease operational costs but also enhance occupant well-being through improved air quality and natural lighting.
sentences.paraphrase: By reducing energy consumption, these technologies provide dual benefits: lower maintenance expenses and better living conditions for residents who enjoy cleaner air and more daylight.
sentences.tip: 명사 형태(innovations)를 동사 형태(technologies)로 변환하고, 'both A and B' 구조를 'dual benefits: A and B' 형태로 재구성

sentences.original: Regulatory frameworks in Europe mandate that new constructions meet stringent sustainability standards.
sentences.paraphrase: European governments enforce strict regulations requiring all newly built structures to adhere to demanding environmental performance criteria.
sentences.tip: 능동태(mandate that) → 수동태(enforce... requiring) 변환 및 동의어 활용(stringent→demanding, standards→criteria)

speaking.prompt: Some people prefer shopping online. Others prefer shopping in physical stores. Which do you prefer and why? Include specific reasons and details in your response.
model_sentences: Personally, I prefer shopping in physical stores rather than online because I value the hands-on experience and immediate gratification.
First, when I shop in stores, I can see and touch the products directly, which helps me make better decisions about quality and fit.
For example, when I buy clothes, I can try them on right away to ensure they fit properly, whereas online shopping requires me to wait days for delivery and deal with potential returns.
Additionally, in-store shopping allows me to interact with knowledgeable staff who can provide personalized recommendations and answer my questions instantly.
Overall, although online shopping offers convenience, I believe the ability to inspect products immediately and receive expert guidance makes physical store shopping a better option for me.

listening.title: Student Inquiry About Dormitory Assignment
listening.script:
Student A: Good afternoon! I'm here to ask about my dormitory assignment for next semester. I haven't received any notification yet, and I'm getting concerned about housing.

Administrator: Hello! Let me check your file. Can you provide your student ID number?

Student A: Sure, it's 2024-87563.

Administrator: Thank you. I see your application here. Actually, assignments are typically sent by email about two weeks before the semester begins. Since registration period just closed last week, you should expect your notification shortly.

Student A: Oh, I see. So there's no issue with my application?

Administrator: No, everything appears to be in order. However, I noticed you requested a single room. Unfortunately, our single-room availability is very limited this year due to increased enrollment. There's a possibility you might be assigned to a double room instead.

Student A: Hmm, I was really hoping for a single. Is there anything I can do about that?

Administrator: You can submit a formal appeal with specific justification. Medical conditions or documented circumstances are considered more favorably. The appeal deadline is August 15th.

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the conversation?
options: To discuss the cost of dormitory accommodation
To inquire about the status of a dormitory assignment
To complain about the quality of student housing
To request a transfer to a different university residence hall
questions.explanation: 학생이 '기숙사 배정에 대한 통지를 받지 못했고 걱정하고 있다'고 말하며 이에 대해 문의합니다. 대화의 주요 목적은 기숙사 배정 상태를 확인하는 것입니다. 정답은 B입니다.

questions.q: According to the administrator, when will the student typically receive the dormitory assignment notification?
options: Immediately after submitting the application
About two weeks before the semester begins
On the first day of class
After the appeal deadline
questions.explanation: 관리자가 'assignments are typically sent by email about two weeks before the semester begins'라고 명확히 설명합니다. 정답은 B입니다.

questions.q: Why does the administrator mention that a double room might be assigned instead of a single room?
options: To punish students who request single rooms
To explain that single-room availability is limited due to increased enrollment
To increase dormitory revenue
To encourage students to share rooms
questions.explanation: 관리자는 'our single-room availability is very limited this year due to increased enrollment'라고 설명하며, 이것이 이중실 배정 가능성의 이유임을 분명히 합니다. 정답은 B입니다.
